content:
Aisha (CSM): FYI flagged Solstice Media as at-risk — renewal in 28d, usage down ~48% month-over-month, 3 tickets about embeddings/ingestion. Thinking a short, surgical 'safety stitch' play to stabilize and buy time for a proper onboarding re-run. :warning:
Benji (Solutions): Agree. Can you share the usage slices? Is this broad drop or specific pipelines?
Aisha (CSM): Most of the drop is from their content-enrichment pipeline — errors spiked after a schema change last month. They're on Dedicated. Logs show a lot of 400s from the ingestion endpoint.
Marta (Enablement): We should do a 45-min hands-on lab with their ops team — focus on schema mapping + data validation templates. I can run it Tues/Wed. :calendar: 
Carlos (AE): Do we want to offer a short credit as a goodwill gesture? Might help tone down renewal friction.
Benji (Solutions): Yes to the lab + a tactical fix first. I can review the ingestion code with them and submit a hotfix to their pipeline. If we can get errors <5% and uplift usage by 15% in a week, we set a clear runway.
Aisha (CSM): Proposed quick plan:
```
1) Immediate: Benji do triage + hotfix (target 24-48h)
2) 48-72h: Marta runs enablement lab (45m) + share validation templates
3) 72h-7d: Apply temporary usage credit and enable priority support
4) Week 1 check: measure ingestion success rate and DAU lift
5) If >15% lift -> standard renewal motion. Else -> escalate to exec sponsor call
```
Marta (Enablement): I'll create a one-pager checklist and a short recording of the validation steps after the lab.
Carlos (AE): I'll prep a renewal note that frames the credit as a customer success gesture tied to outcomes, not a pricing concession.
eng-ops-bot: Incident watch created for Solstice Media (INC-20277). Auto-alerts: ingestion-error-rate > 10% -> CS oncall ping.
Benji (Solutions): I'll take the triage. @Aisha can you drop 2-3 example failed payloads in thread or DM me?
Aisha (CSM): Dropping two sanitized payload examples and logs to Benji now. Also adding the customer contact list: "Sasha (Ops)", "Tom (Data)".
Carlos (AE): I'll schedule the renewal checkpoint with their sponsor for 7 days out (tentative).
Marta (Enablement): Tentative lab slot Wed 11am PT. I'll send calendar invite to Solstice and our leads.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update the customer record with the safety-stitch play and set a follow-up on day 7. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have actions in motion.
Benji (Solutions): :thumbsup: starting triage now.
Marta (Enablement): :thumbsup:
Carlos (AE): :thumbsup:
